original_test_intent: Capture one verified sensor's current assertion and deassertion event-status bitmap over OOB, identify any live or latched condition under its SDR event type, and preserve the state without re-arming or clearing evidence.
original_method: Preserve Master TBD; Review maps the title to IPMI v2.0 Table 35-14 raw 0x04/0x2B <sensor number> with status/control and assertion/deassertion fields decoded through the matched SDR.
manual_activity: Project supplies the approved sensor/SDR mapping and expected fault context; ordinary read-only status capture needs no interactive confirmation.
required_inputs: Matched SDR sensor type and event/reading type
Expected operating/fault context and evidence timestamp
safety_requirements: Do not re-arm or change event enables/thresholds
Do not clear active or historical fault evidence
agent_execution_scope: Bind the sensor number to one SDR and event schema
Capture timestamp and surrounding read-only monitoring context
Validate completion, scanning/event-message state and reading/state-unavailable
Decode assertion/deassertion bits only when available
Correlate active bits with current reading and preserved event history
Archive raw and decoded no-mutation evidence
engineer_actions: Approve sensor mapping and expected context
Investigate live, latched or unsupported status

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek is safe but too restrictive: the standard status read becomes deterministic after sensor/SDR mapping and requires no state mutation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use one secret-safe raw 0x04 0x2b <sensor number> request as defined by IPMI v2.0 Table 35-14; validate the status byte and decode assertion/deassertion event bits according to the matched threshold or discrete SDR only when reading/state is available.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: No Master command or expected state is invented; source TBD and 10/5 timing remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Take one timestamped status snapshot, gate event-bit interpretation on availability and SDR type, and correlate active bits with current reading and existing event history without modifying latch state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a protocol-defined Review read while leaving the source TBD intact.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This does not prove event re-arm, enable-mask writes, threshold configuration or stimulus-driven event generation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A single snapshot may race sensor scanning; unavailable or transitioning state requires preservation and escalation, not retry-until-clear.

project_override_considerations: A higher-level API is equivalent only if it identifies the same sensor, exposes availability plus assertion/deassertion state without consuming or clearing it, and documents event-bit mapping.
expected_evidence: Decoded assertion/deassertion bits with availability gate
Current reading and preserved SEL/BMC/OS correlation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title consistently identifies Get Sensor Event Status while Procedure and Criteria are TBD. Missing command, schema and oracle plus generic log clearing are omissions, not contradictory source requirements; the conditional Review mapping preserves Master TBD.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read command and status model are identifiable. Sensor/SDR mapping and expected context are Project inputs; an unavailable or ambiguous live status is an execution finding to escalate without mutation.

review_improvement: Makes reading/state-unavailable an explicit interpretation gate, ties every event bit to the sensor's event type and prohibits automatic re-arm that would destroy the snapshot being tested.
independent_technical_reasoning: Event-status bits are not self-describing: the same bit positions represent threshold transitions or discrete states according to the SDR. In addition, a sensor update can make the status temporarily unavailable. Valid evidence therefore needs the exact SDR, the availability/control byte and a timestamped raw bitmap; treating zeros during unavailable state as healthy or re-arming before capture would invalidate the result.
